repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repositories.summary: 一套面向真实工程实践的AI代理技能集，包含代码开发与效率工具，可通过插件或脚本快速安装使用。

repositories.name: ponytail
repositories.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repositories.summary: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 插件，通过规则和钩子让 AI 编程代理遵循极简编码风格，优先选择最简单方案并避免不必要代码。

repositories.name: fmt
repositories.summary: fmtlib/fmt 是一个现代 C++ 格式化库，提供快速安全的字符串格式化功能，可作为 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 的替代方案。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、规则、记忆与安全配置的性能优化系统，用于增强代理的工程协作能力。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.summary: Anthropic 官方发布的 Agent Skills 示例仓库，包含各类技能文件夹、规范与模板，用于指导 Claude 完成特定任务。

repositories.name: humanizer
repositories.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
repositories.summary: Humanizer 是一个智能体技能，通过识别并改写 35 种 AI 写作模式，将机器生成的文本润色为自然的人类文风，同时保留原意、代码与数据。

repositories.name: hermes-agent
repositories.description: The agent that grows with you
repositories.summary: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 开发的自改进 AI 代理，具备内置学习循环，可通过 CLI 或消息网关使用，并支持从 OpenClaw 迁移。

repositories.name: caveman
repositories.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman
repositories.summary: 一个通过让AI代理用简短原始风格回复及本地代理压缩读取内容来减少token消耗的开源工具。

repositories.name: magnitude
repositories.description: Open source inference server that runs the best local models for your hardware, plugged into the agent you already use. Works with Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Oh My Pi, and Cline.
repositories.summary: Magnitude 是一个开源推理服务器，能根据硬件配置推荐并运行本地模型，供 AI 代理离线使用。

repositories.name: exploitarium
repositories.description: A single archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups. At the time I post these, none have been reported. Feel free to report them yourself and take credit for the CVE if handed out lulz. Please do not abuse these. I do this so to allure people into the field, and I've always found this is the most efficient way.
repositories.summary: 一个公开漏洞利用概念验证代码与漏洞研究文章的归档仓库，收录了作者发布的多项漏洞研究成果。

repositories.name: fanqiang
repositories.summary: 一个汇集翻墙工具、教程和新闻的仓库，提供多平台科学上网指南及Chrome一键翻墙包。

repositories.name: VoiceStudio
repositories.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repositories.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的本地语音工具，支持声音克隆、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖多种语言。

repositories.name: timesfm
repositories.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
repositories.summary: TimesFM 是谷歌研究开发的时间序列基础模型，用于时间序列预测，支持单变量和多变量预测。

repositories.name: miles
repositories.description: Miles is an enterprise-facing reinforcement learning framework for LLM and VLM post-training, forked from and co-evolving with slime.
repositories.summary: Miles是一个面向企业的强化学习框架，用于大规模语言模型和视觉语言模型的后训练，支持高性能训练与推理。

repositories.name: opencode
repositories.summary: opencode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，支持命令行和桌面应用，可辅助开发与代码探索。

repositories.name: renodx
repositories.summary: RenoDX 是一套基于 Reshade 插件系统的 DirectX 游戏修改工具集，支持替换着色器、注入缓冲、添加覆盖层及升级交换链等。

repositories.name: diagram-design
repositories.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repositories.summary: 为Claude Code等AI编程工具提供38种编辑级HTML+SVG图表模板，可生成无阴影、风格统一的静态图表。
